name: a-sentinel-behind-a-link-is-not-an-account
breaks: the sentinel is read off the raw value again instead of the bare username, so a sentinel arriving as a pasted profile link or behind a second sigil is accepted as an account here and refused by Python. TypedCredit then reads it as a mention and weekTags strips it down, so 'unknown' lands in the TAG LIST Dan pastes into Instagram (#917, #926)
